abilities.name: Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire
abilities.caveat: After Chevreuse fires a shot, she restores HP to the active character on the field every 2s for 12s, based on her Max HP. The amount shown is per heal tick.
_curatorNotes: Hold variant cooldownStartDelay is dynamic: hold+13 frames (base 13 at minimum hold). Hold frames are also dynamic: actual cancel frame = hold + base-offset; variant frames below record the base-offset slice values (minimum hold). C4 suppresses Hold cooldown for 2 uses or 6s after Q cast.

Heal authored 2026-07-12 as an onCast(skill) heal-over-time on the ability with target 'active' and duration:12 — Dori Alcazarzaray's Exactitude shape (periodic active-character heal window with no spawned entity; the schema has no non-summon tick-interval field, so the 2s cadence is documented here + surfaced via caveat rather than encoded). gcsim skill.go startSkillHealing → Core.Player.Heal(Target: Core.Player.Active()), Src = skillHpRegen[TalentLvlSkill]*MaxHP + skillHpFlat[TalentLvlSkill]. TL10 (index 9, chevreuse_gen.go): skillHpRegen[9]=0.048 → scaling 4.8% Max HP; skillHpFlat[9]=564.98486 → flat 564.985 (sidecar 'HP Regeneration Over Time' col 10 = '4.80% Max HP+565'). Value authored is per-tick — 6 ticks over the 12s window (skillHealInterval=120f=2s; first tick at 2s after CDStart via Tasks.Add(startSkillHealing, skillHealInterval); heal-status skillDur = 12*60+1f so the final tick lands on expiry). Heal fires on BOTH skillPress (skillHeal(skillPressCDStart=18)) and skillHold (skillHeal(cdStart=hold+13)) — not Hold-only. C4 retrigger refreshes the same skillHealKey status (durationType left default; single 12s window models the C0 canonical case).
Arkhe: Ousia 'Surging Blade' fires on skill hit with 10s ICD (600 frames), dealing Ousia-aligned Pyro DMG as Elemental Skill DMG. Not modeled — needs reviewer pass.

Overcharged Ball: Chevreuse gains 1 ball per nearby party Overloaded trigger (max 1). When active, Hold mode fires 'Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire [Overcharged]' instead of regular hold shot, dealing greater AoE Pyro DMG and consuming the ball; also triggers A4 (a4() queued at cdStart). Not modeled — needs reviewer pass.
abilities.description:
Chevreuse quickly shoulders her musket and fires at her opponent(s), dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
For a short duration after Chevreuse fires a shot, she will continuously restore HP to your active character on the field. The amount healed is based on her Max HP.
Hold to fire in a different fashion.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode, locking a target in her sights to fire a precise interdiction shot. If Chevreuse has an Overcharged Ball, then she will fire the Overcharged Ball instead, dealing greater Pyro DMG in a larger area.
Chevreuse gains 1 Overcharged Ball every time a nearby character in the party triggers an Overloaded reaction, and can have up to 1 Overcharged Ball at a time.

Arkhe: Ousia
Periodically, after Chevreuse's Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire hits, a Surging Blade will be called forth that deals Ousia-aligned Pyro DMG.

abilities.name: Ring of Bursting Grenades
abilities.description:
Chevreuse fires an explosive grenade at opponents with her musket, dealing AoE Pyro DMG. After the projectile hits, it will split into many secondary explosive shells.
The secondary explosive shells will burst after a short interval, dealing Pyro DMG to nearby opponents.

passives.name: Vanguard's Coordinated Tactics
_curatorNotes: Party composition condition (all party members must be Pyro or Electro with at least one of each) is not gated on the effect — the planner doesn't enforce the Pyro+Electro-only team requirement, so the shred renders whenever Overloaded fires.
passives.description:
When all party members are Pyro and Electro characters and there is at least one Pyro and one Electro character each in the party:
Chevreuse grants "Coordinated Tactics" to nearby party members: After a character triggers the Overloaded reaction, the Pyro and Electro RES of the opponent(s) affected by this Overloaded reaction will be decreased by 40% for 6s.
The "Coordinated Tactics" effect will be removed when the Elemental Types of the characters in the party do not meet the basic requirements for the Ascension Talent.

constellations.name: Sniper Induced Explosion
_curatorNotes: Migrated to onHit ability:skill with filter.damageTag:'skillHold' 2026-05-09 (G primitive). gcsim c2() AttackCBFunc is only passed to skillHold's QueueAttack, not skillPress; the Hold variant on the parent skill carries the default skillHold tag (auto-derived from input:['hE']). 10s procCooldown matches the gcsim ICD. Fires 2 chain explosions per proc — authored as a single damage effect with 240% combined scaling would over-compress; 120% per explosion is the canonical per-instance value with the actual 2× multiplicity captured implicitly in the proc semantic.
constellations.description: After Holding Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire and hitting a target, 2 chain explosions will be triggered near the location where said target is hit. Each explosion deals Pyro DMG equal to 120% of Chevreuse's ATK. This effect can be triggered up to once every 10s, and DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
